history.evaluator_summary: Adds a virtual workspace (resolver 2) with onlypassword-core (lib, non-default features insecure-fast-kdf and test-hooks) and onlypassword-cli (bin 'onlypassword'). It declares no dependencies, carries forbid(unsafe_code) and the cfg_attr clippy denies in both crate roots, and has one trivial test per crate and a committed Cargo.lock. I ran cargo build (produces target/debug/onlypassword), cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings (clean, with unwrap in tests) and cargo test (2 pass). I did not re-run gate.sh; I relied on the stated pass. No crypto or secret code is involved.

Adds the Error enum (identical to architecture.md, fixed-string Display, std::error::Error, Result alias) and SecretString/SecretVec/SecretBytes<N> secret containers. Each derives Zeroize+ZeroizeOnDrop, has a manual redacted Debug, and has no Display, Serialize or Clone. Only the zeroize dependency was added (derive feature). The new Cargo.lock entries are zeroize_derive and its proc-macro dependencies. I ran cargo test and all 8 core tests pass. No blocker or major findings.
